meta.title: Short Drama Studio
meta.description: Left-sidebar workbench that turns a script into storyboard panels with Gemini using editable preset rules, then generates videos through the Xiaoyunque and Dreamina CLIs. It links workspace assets (images, voices, videos), sets ratio/duration/model, tracks jobs, and downloads finished videos into a chosen project folder. Requires a configured Gemini provider or GEMINI_API_KEY, and both CLIs on PATH.
